card.name: Period ending an article's final sentence
card.fires_on: The period closing the last sentence of a web article, news story or press release, just before credits, author notes, disclaimers or links to other articles. It is strongest after acknowledgments, funding notes and author bios.

modes.label: Period before disclaimer or credits
modes.description: The full stop after an author bio, publisher list or contribution note, right before a disclaimer or byline text.

modes.label: Period before related links
modes.description: The full stop ending the body text of a news or science piece, followed by source lines, reference lists or other-article links.
modes.example: The study was published recently by the Astrophysical Journal<<. >>The Daily Galaxy via Carnegie Institution for Science

card.plain: It fires on the full stop that ends the main text of an online article, just before the credits or footer material begins.
